analyst.summary: Concord Biotech is a specialized, fermentation-based API and CDMO maker with a debt-free balance sheet and historically strong margins, focused on hard-to-replicate immunosuppressant and oncology molecules. Revenue and profit have both dipped over the last year, which looks like a demand/destocking-driven soft patch rather than a structural problem, since margins have stayed healthy throughout. We rate it a Hold: business quality is high, but the near-term growth picture needs to show a clear turn before we would call this cheap.
